Class PovVideoEncoder

java.lang.Object
com.soulfiremc.server.renderer.PovVideoEncoder
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class PovVideoEncoder extends Object implements AutoCloseable
One persistent, zero-reordering H.264 encoder. All calls are serialized by the stream owner.
